$comment: Write-path responses transcribed from what the panel returned at firmware 1.21 (spec §2.5, issue #7, register Q29/Q36/Q37/Q56/Q57). Each file is the body as it would come off the wire. The conformance probe, run with writes enabled, saves the real responses into observed/fw-<version>/ and those replace these.

write-echo-heatingSetpoint.json.source: §2.5: the echo reports the applied value, type-normalised (19 for 19.0); Q5, Q37

write-echo-openWindowDetection.json.source: §2.5: the echo uses the exact parameter name sent, flat; Q3, Q5

write-echo-sensorMode-inert.json.source: §2.5, Q58: echoes true while the device keeps false — the silent undo. The client returns the echo; the coordinator's refresh is the authority

reset-envelope.json.source: Q57: a reset returns the uniform status envelope, capitalised Success; no reset key

error-400-step.txt.reason: minimumTemperatureLimit must be step values of 0.5
error-400-step.txt.source: §2.5 punctuation style 3, Q1: the limits reject an off-step value

error-400-outrange.txt.reason: heatingSetpoint outrange of temperature limit(min or max)

error-400-limits.txt.reason: minimumTemperatureLimit is greater than current max temperature limit or equal to it

error-404.txt.source: Q29: an unknown path is a CherryPy default 404, text/html
